## GovernanceContext type

Shared governance state for a surface: the active policy to enforce, an audit writer to record decisions, and — optionally — an approval gate.

When `policy` permits everything (allow-all) and `writer` is omitted, enforcement is a near-no-op.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type GovernanceContext = GovernanceContextWithoutApprovals | GovernanceContextWithApprovals
```

**References:** [GovernanceContextWithoutApprovals](./runtime.governancecontextwithoutapprovals.md)<!-- -->, [GovernanceContextWithApprovals](./runtime.governancecontextwithapprovals.md)
